items.title: UKMTO reports outbound tanker struck and burning in Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: UKMTO warning 214-26 reports that an outbound tanker was struck by an unknown projectile north of Khasab, Oman, with a fire onboard. Reuters independently relayed the warning. Initial reporting states no casualties or environmental impact; there is no independently established sustained export or transit shutdown. The cause and damage assessment remain unresolved.

observations.label: Incident time and place
observations.value: November 20, 2026, 15:00 UTC / 10:00 AM EST; 8 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman; outbound Strait of Hormuz tanker

observations.label: UKMTO warning 214-26
observations.value: Port bow hit by unidentified projectile; company security officer reports onboard fire; initially no casualties or environmental impact reported

observations.label: Alternative attribution
observations.value: Reuters reports Iran's Revolutionary Guards attributed fire to mine, an unverified and disputed cause; no independent forensic confirmation

observations.label: Physical-flow evidence and next checks
observations.value: Tanker strike/fire reported, but no confirmed sustained oil throughput loss or strait closure; monitor UKMTO/MARAD, crew/ship identification, damage, AIS/transit, Yanbu loading, freight/insurance; confirmed normal flows weaken disruption signal

items.key_finding: Reported physical tanker attack and fire raise immediate Hormuz shipping risk; no verified sustained oil-flow loss.

items.title: Afternoon selling accelerates: Nasdaq over 4% lower as semiconductor rout continues
items.summary: US selling accelerated during Friday afternoon, taking the Nasdaq well beyond its midday decline and pushing the S&P 500 deeper into correction territory intraday. Semiconductor shares remained especially weak. The dislocation reflects a sharp reassessment of AI valuations and financing assumptions, not verified uniform collapse in chip orders. Intraday moves are not closing returns.

observations.label: November 20 afternoon intraday snapshot
observations.value: MarketWatch reported Nasdaq approximately -4.5% (about -1,080 points), S&P 500 about -3%, Dow about -1.4%; not closing figures

observations.label: Sector and intraday breadth
observations.value: Barron's reported PHLX semiconductor index approximately -9%, with losses accelerating after about 1:55 PM EST; technology concentration substantial

observations.label: Fundamental risks
observations.value: Hyperscaler AI capex returns, highly valued semiconductors, funding costs and possible leveraged-liquidation pressure; pricing alone does not prove earnings or demand impairment

observations.label: Next indicators / invalidation
observations.value: Closing breadth and prices, VIX, yields, credit spreads, semiconductor customer orders, earnings revisions; sustained market rebound alongside resilient orders weakens further downside assessment

items.key_finding: Afternoon selling intensified materially beyond midday levels; AI-chip valuation and funding concerns dominate.

items.title: Savara sinks after FDA says molgramostim decision will miss November 22 target
items.summary: Savara says the FDA will not decide on its molgramostim application by November 22 and gave no revised action date. Shares fell sharply during Friday trading. The regulatory delay extends cash-flow and financing uncertainty for the rare-lung-disease developer, but review continues and this is not an FDA rejection.

observations.label: November 20, 12:25 PM EST indicative trading
observations.value: RTTNews reported SVRA around $4.39, -15.38%; intraday, not closing return

observations.label: Company disclosure November 20
observations.value: FDA will not take action by November 22, 2026 PDUFA date for molgramostim BLA for autoimmune pulmonary alveolar proteinosis; no revised date; review ongoing

observations.label: Fundamentals and risks
observations.value: Single important regulatory asset, timing uncertainty and possible financing needs; an extended wait or adverse review would worsen risk

observations.label: Next indicators and invalidation
observations.value: FDA communications, revised action date, manufacturing/CMC status, cash runway and regulatory decision; prompt favorable review changes thesis

items.key_finding: A confirmed FDA timing delay, not rejection, triggered a double-digit intraday SVRA decline.

sources.title: RTTNews November 20 SVRA price and FDA report

items.title: UKMTO reports armed skiff firing on eastbound bulk carrier in Gulf of Aden
items.summary: UKMTO warning 213-26 records a master-reported encounter southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen. Six armed people approached an eastbound bulk carrier and fired four shots; shipboard security returned warning shots and the skiff withdrew. The vessel continued with no reported injuries or damage. No oil-cargo loss or sustained route disruption has been verified.

observations.label: Incident time and location
observations.value: November 20, 2026, 11:02 UTC / 6:02 AM EST; 95 nautical miles southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen, in IRTC

observations.label: UKMTO official warning 213-26
observations.value: Bulk carrier approached by skiff with six armed people; four shots fired and warning shots returned; skiff withdrew; vessel continued eastbound

observations.label: Verified physical consequences
observations.value: Master reported no vessel damage and no crew injuries; vessel/assailant identities and attribution unverified; no confirmed oil-export or freight interruption

observations.label: Market assessment and next indicators
observations.value: No independently verified incident-specific XLE/XOP move; monitor UKMTO/MARAD follow-ups, additional encounters, Bab el-Mandeb transit volumes, insurance and freight costs; continued safe passage weakens disruption implication

items.key_finding: New official armed-encounter report raises Gulf of Aden security concern without evidence of interrupted cargo flows.

items.title: Anthropic completes $119.5B total IPO and placement financing as shares retreat toward issue price
items.summary: Anthropic confirmed the full exercise of its IPO underwriters' option and closing of a $26 billion strategic private placement, taking aggregate gross proceeds including selling stockholder shares to about $119.5 billion. Shares fell sharply toward the $83 IPO price in Friday premarket trading. Liquidity improves, but profitability, massive compute commitments and concentrated supplier financing remain uncertain.

observations.label: November 20 pre-opening observation; Business Insider and Financial Times
observations.value: ANT approximately $84.84, down about 12.5% versus November 19 closing $97.17; FT reports as much as 13% lower premarket; not confirmed closing performance

observations.label: November 20 confirmed IPO closing; company announcement and Reuters
observations.value: 1,127,000,000 Class A shares at $83; gross offering $93.5B, including fully exercised 147M-share option and secondary proceeds; company receives ~$91.6B of offering gross

observations.label: November 20 completed private placement; Anthropic
observations.value: $26.0B Class N shares subscribed by AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC Partners; total aggregate gross offering plus placement ~$119.5B including selling shareholders' shares

observations.label: Fundamentals, risks and invalidation
observations.value: Liquidity improves but computing commitments, dilution, supplier financing concentration and operating losses persist; watch ANT near $83 issue price, revenue and margins, AI sector breadth and financing rates; better cash generation or demand confirmation weakens downside thesis

items.key_finding: Record AI financing closed, but substantial premarket reversal underscores the gap between capital raised and proven cash economics.
